header.running_head: Hadhrat Umar (RA) Consults with the Sahabah (RA) Concerning a Military Offensive Against the Persians

blocks.text: and they were still busy consulting when a letter arrived from Hadhrat Sa'd (RA), who had been employed to collect zakaah of the people of Najd. When Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked those with him to suggest who should command the army, Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) said, "You have just found him." "Who is he?" asked Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan (RA) replied, "He is the clawed and valiant lion Sa'd bin Maalik (RA)." The other members of the consultative assembly agreed.[^1]
Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) Encourages People Towards Jihaad

Hadhrat Abu Saalih who was the freed slave of Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) narrates that he heard Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) saying from the pulpit, "O people! I had kept secret from you a Hadith that I had heard from Rasulullaah ﷺ fearing that you would disperse from around me (and proceed in Jihaad). I then decided to mention it to you so that each person may decide to do as he pleases. I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'A single day spent guarding the borders (of the Muslim state) for the pleasure of Allaah is better than a thousand other days spent at other places'."[^2]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Mus'ab bin Thaabit bin Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Mus'ab bin Thaabit bin Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) mentioned the following in a sermon from the pulpit: "I intent narrating to you a Hadith that I had heard from Rasulullaah ﷺ. All that prevented me from narrating it to you previously was to keep you behind with me (here in Madinah to tend to the affairs of the capital city). I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'A single day spent guarding the borders (of the Muslim state) for the pleasure of Allaah is better than a thousand other days spent in salaah coupled with days spent fasting'."[^3]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) Encourages People Towards Jihaad

Hadhrat Zaid bin Wahab narrates that Hadhrat Ali (RA) once stood up to address the people. He said, "All praises belong to Allaah Who when He crushes something, none can mend it and when He wants something to remain intact, none can smash it. If Allaah wills, no two persons would have a quarrel and the Ummah would never dispute any of His laws. Similarly, if He wills, no underling would reject the virtue of his superiors. Fate has drawn us and the others to this place. Allaah sees and hears us and if He wills, He could hasten our punishment. Allaah controls change and has the power to expose the oppressor and make it known where the truth lies. Nevertheless, Allaah has made this world a place of actions and has made the Aakhirah a place to live forever.

blocks.arabic_text: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسَآءُوْا بِمَا عَمِلُوْا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا بِالْحُسْنٰى
